title: Bell and Smile
author: Wren Yarrow
blurb: Lior Crane, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
